start.why: GitHub Copilot docs, adding repository instructions: .github/copilot-instructions.md applies to every request in the repository

GitHub Copilot docs, agent instructions: one or more AGENTS.md anywhere in the repository, the nearest to the file in play wins, or a single CLAUDE.md or GEMINI.md at the root

alsoReads.why: GitHub Copilot docs: applyTo globs select the files, and excludeAgent keeps the file away from code review or the cloud agent

mcp.verified: GitHub Copilot MCP docs (read 2026-10-14): the VS Code extension reads .vscode/mcp.json; Copilot CLI reads .mcp.json, .github/mcp.json or ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json; a repository-level configuration entered on github.com is not a file at all

loader.verified: GitHub Copilot documentation (docs.github.com/en/copilot, read 2026-10-14) — repository-wide instructions live at .github/copilot-instructions.md; path-specific instructions live at .github/instructions/**/NAME.instructions.md with applyTo globs and an optional excludeAgent; agent instructions are one or more AGENTS.md anywhere in the repository, nearest wins, or a single root CLAUDE.md or GEMINI.md; no byte cap is published
loader.note: Which Copilot reader consumes these differs — the cloud agent and code review are documented as reading repository and path-specific instructions — so the row is one reader with a split, the same split `surfaces.mjs` records on the copilot row.
